description: Open WebUI (GPU build): the CUDA-accelerated image of Open WebUI, for running local Whisper transcription and embedding models on an NVIDIA GPU in addition to chatting with Ollama/OpenAI-compatible APIs.

env.description: URL of an Ollama instance, e.g. the Ollama template in this app list
env.label: OLLAMA_BASE_URL
env.name: OLLAMA_BASE_URL

name: open-webui-gpu
note: Requires an NVIDIA GPU and the NVIDIA Container Toolkit on the host. After creating this container, attach a GPU to it under Portainer's Runtime & Resources tab (the equivalent of docker run --gpus all) before starting it.
title: Open WebUI (GPU)
